## Summary

Describe the user-visible result and implementation approach.

## Validation

- [ ] `cargo fmt -- --check`
- [ ] `cargo test --locked`
- [ ] `cargo clippy --locked --all-targets -- -D warnings`
- [ ] Tested on macOS
- [ ] Updated tests and documentation where needed

## Performance impact

Include before/after measurements for decoding, caching, navigation or rendering changes. Write “Not applicable” for changes outside the hot path.

## Images and privacy

- [ ] Test fixtures are synthetic, redistributable or excluded from the repository.
